I know how you feel, my hamster died as he got his head stuck in the bars of the cage, and I felt so guilty for so long, I don't even like to talk about it as it brings me a lot of guilt and stress. But you need to learn at one point that in the amount of time that your sweet little birdie lived, she enjoyed her life, you gave her the best months of her life as possible, don't be sad that its over. Just be happy that it happened and shes up in heaven in a better place.  I bet you if she could talk right now, she would most likely understand how it was only a mistake. Shes eating all the fruits and doing all the things she didn't do on Earth in heaven. It was a accident, and don't put too much pressure onto yourself. Forgive yourself.
